pages.text: $(bold)Space exploration is the final frontier.$(/bold)$(br2)To reach space, you need three things: a $(bold)Rocket Workbench$(/bold), a $(bold)rocket$(/bold), and $(bold)fuel$(/bold). None of these are cheap — space is endgame content that requires established T4 infrastructure.

$(bold)Rocket Workbench$(/bold)$(br)The gateway item. Crafted from Netherite, Mekanism Steel Casings, and a T4 progression token. Without this station, no rockets can be built.$(br2)$(bold)Fuel Refining$(/bold)$(br)Ad Astra fuel requires RF-powered refining. You will need $(italic)significant$(/italic) power infrastructure — a coal generator will not cut it. Bring your Mekanism Fusion Reactor or Thermal Dynamos.

$(bold)Oxygen$(/bold)$(br)Space has no oxygen. You need an $(bold)Oxygen Loader$(/bold) to fill your space suit before launch, and oxygen tanks for extended stays. The Oxygen Loader requires continuous RF power.$(br2)$(bold)RF Requirements$(/bold)$(br)All Ad Astra machines consume significantly more RF than default. This is intentional — bringing proper power infrastructure to space is part of the challenge.
